topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I stumbled upon a file on his computer, tucked away in a corner of an old folder, almost hidden. It was a novel, or at least, that’s what the document title suggested. Curiosity pulled me in, and as I started to read, the words became a familiar echo. They were about us, about me, but twisted, colorful, and yet terrifyingly real. Every detail, every conversation, all of it laid bare in this digital manuscript. I can’t shake the image of his hands, fingers dancing over the keys, crafting this intricate, private world. What if this isn’t just a story? What if it’s a glimpse into his thoughts, a place I never knew existed?
